WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.status,
         AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_rem,
         AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_over
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
)
SELECT status,
       AVG(avg_rem) AS avg_remaining,
       AVG(avg_over) AS avg_overspend_rate,
       AVG(avg_rem) / (SELECT AVG(avg_rem) FROM ev) AS remaining_ratio
FROM ev
GROUP BY status
